applicationRequirements.description: Connections and polarities must be clear when they affect the result.
Capacitors and inductors need appropriate initial conditions.
The circuit topology and component behavior must be defined before determining electrical state.

simulationCapability.scope: LLM-generated contextual SVG/PixiJS presentation. Physical quantities are computed from applicable approved capability equation ASTs. Participant names, counts, shapes and environments are unrestricted by the renderer.
limitations: Verified computation requires all relevant behavior to map to declared executable capabilities and their validity domains. Unmapped behavior is explicitly visual-only and unverified.
Verified computation requires all relevant behavior to map to declared executable capabilities and their validity domains. Unmapped behavior is explicitly visual-only and unverified.

conceptVocabulary.guidance: Listed concepts guide interpretation but are not an exhaustive allowlist. An unlisted concept may be introduced only when grounded in the user's confirmed description and an established high-school physics law; explain the law and any assumptions. If that grounding is uncertain, clarify instead of inventing behavior.

visualCapability.scope: Generate or draw procedural visual elements from the confirmed setup, its objects, relations, and quantities. Never require a fixed asset catalog entry for an object.
visualCapability.purpose: An explanatory visual illustrates the phenomenon and declared assumptions. It is not evidence of a numerical physical simulation.
visualCapability.interaction: Changing parameter controls recomputes backend solver fields; PixiJS updates the generated SVG layers from those fields. Decorative presentation controls remain separate from physics.
